engine.description: DreamCo's local-first discovery engine for Buddy specialists, capabilities, divisions, models, providers, systems, libraries, and public pages.

rules: Never present outbound links as DreamCo-indexed web results.
A user must choose a provider before a browser search opens.
Buddy research prompts must request current sources and citations.
Do not transmit repository content, personal data, credentials, or stored memory as part of a web query.
